crossRefs.note: All Israel shall hear, and fear, and shall not do any more wickedness like this among you.
The hands of the witnesses shall be first on him to put him to death, and afterward the hands of all the people. So you…
All the people shall hear and fear, and do no more presumptuously.
All the men of his city shall stone him to death with stones. So you shall remove the evil from among you. All Israel…
When the mocker is punished, the simple gains wisdom. When the wise is instructed, he receives knowledge.
For rulers are not a terror to the good work, but to the evil. Do you desire to have no fear of the authority? Do that…
for he is a servant of God to you for good. But if you do that which is evil, be afraid, for he doesn’t bear the sword…
Those who sin, reprove in the sight of all, that the rest also may be in fear.

translations.web: Those who remain shall hear, and fear, and will never again commit any such evil among you.
translations.bsb: Then the rest of the people will hear and be afraid, and they will never again do anything so evil among you.
translations.kjv: And those which remain shall hear, and fear, and shall henceforth commit no more any such evil among
translations.asv: And those that remain shall hear, and fear, and shall henceforth commit no more any such evil in the midst of thee.
